# run
# note a file is a collection: every exchange is sent, in the order it has them
>>> f.rr
-- one --
GET {{url}}/a HTTP/1.1

-- two --
GET {{url}}/b HTTP/1.1

>>> want f.rr
-- one --
GET {{url}}/a HTTP/1.1

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 1
Content-Type: text/plain

a
-- two --
GET {{url}}/b HTTP/1.1

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 1
Content-Type: text/plain

b
>>> stdout
-- one --
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 1
Content-Type: text/plain

a
-- two --
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 1
Content-Type: text/plain

b
